headline: A big first down for Kansas City
what_happened: K.Walker ran the ball forward to gain five yards, which gives the Chiefs a fresh set of four tries to move the ball.
who: The play featured K.Walker running and C.Bynum defending.
why_it_matters: This keeps the drive alive with very little time remaining. Even though the win chance dropped slightly, getting this first down is vital for trying to score before the clock runs out.
